topic: The $214 record grilled cheese vs a $3 diner sandwich
style: Photorealistic luxury food look, dark and rich with gold accents
requestedEnding: Asks the viewer whether they would pay it, then promises part two

storyArc.goal: Show a $214 record sandwich next to a plain diner sandwich.
storyArc.obstacle: Why does it cost so much: champagne bread, rare cheese, gold.
storyArc.turn: The gold adds no flavor; the cheese is the star.
storyArc.visualBible: Dark marble, warm light, gold accents, photorealistic food photography, no people faces.

plan.title: Same Grilled Cheese, Two Prices: $3 vs $214
plan.hook: Same grilled cheese, two prices: three dollars, or two hundred fourteen.
plan.payoff: Would you pay two hundred fourteen dollars for this? Follow for part two!
claimsToCheck: Guinness World Records: most expensive sandwich, Quintessential Grilled Cheese, Serendipity 3, New York, US $214, 29 October 2014; French Pullman bread made with Dom Perignon champagne and edible gold flakes, white truffle butter, Caciocavallo Podolico (guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/most-expensive-sandwich)

CNBC 11 Apr 2023: about half a pound of caciocavallo podolico, retails for over $50 per pound; reviewer found the gold adds no flavor and the cheese is the highlight; normally needs 48 hours notice (cnbc.com/2023/04/11/the-worlds-most-expensive-sandwich-is-a-gold-covered-grilled-cheese.html)
The $3 diner sandwich is an illustrative everyday price, not a sourced figure

shots.imagePrompt: A golden-brown grilled cheese sandwich cut diagonally on a dark plate, one half pulled away on a long stretch of melted cheese, flakes of gold leaf on the cut edge, and a plain diner grilled cheese on a white paper plate at lower left. Photorealistic high-end product photograph. A dark marble counter in a warm restaurant. Vertical 9:16 frame, camera 30 degrees above the counter, sandwich centred, paper-plate sandwich at lower left. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the sandwich. Bright warm key light from the upper left with golden highlights. Crisp buttered crust, glossy melted cheese, gold leaf. Clear space around the cheese strand, steam can rise, simple background.
shots.motionPrompt: The camera glides smoothly to the right along the counter, revealing the gold-flecked sandwich as the cheese strand stretches and steam rises; the paper-plate sandwich stays in the lower left.
shots.sound: Soft sizzle, a gentle whoosh as the camera glides, and a gold shimmer
